{{Quote|Go find Masters Raskta and Worror. They also served with Hoth on Ruusan. They will join us in our cause.|Valenthyne Farfalla|<ref name="rot" />}}
'''Raskta Lsu''' was an [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and a soldier in [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth's]] [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]]. She was named after the legendary Echani [[Raskta Fenni]], who was also regarded as the greatest warrior of her time. Because of this, Lsu aspired to equal and then surpass the renown of her namesake. Thus, her entire [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] career was spent honing her martial skills exclusively, and with time her mastery of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was such that many considered her peerless in its application. Lsu was so renowned for her battle skills that she was granted the vaunted title of [[Jedi Weapon Master|Weapons Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Lsu displayed her talents during the [[New Sith Wars]], fighting in many battles against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].

[[990 BBY|Ten years]] after the [[Ruusan campaign|final campaign]] which ended the war on the planet [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], Raskta Lsu was part of a team of Jedi selected by [[Jedi Lord|Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] to embark on a [[Duel on Tython|mission]] to the fabled Jedi [[Homeworld/Legends|birth world]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], in attempt to eliminate the [[Order of the Sith Lords|last two remaining]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Darth/Legends|Darths]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Bane]] and [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]]. Upon arriving and landing on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world, Farfalla's Jedi team engaged the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and Lsu once again displayed her skill with the lightsaber. She fought valiantly, and was the only one of the five Jedi to match Bane's own power with the blade. However, she was undone by the [[Spell of concealment|wiles]] of Darth Zannah, who snuck up behind Lsu and [[Shiak|impaled]] her, thus [[Death/Legends|ending]] the Jedi Master's life.

==Biography==
===Life as a Jedi===
Named for the legendary [[Echani/Legends|Echani warrior]] [[Raskta Fenni]], Raskta Lsu was also an Echani, a [[Species/Legends|race]] of [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] whose culture was centered on perfection of oneself through physical combat. As a youth, she aspired to become like Fenni, who was heralded by many as the greatest warrior of her time. Thus, she followed the traditions of her people, and devoted her entire life to martial skills.<ref name="rot" />

Being [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Lsu was also accepted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and eventually achieved the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]]. During that time she spent little time strengthening her [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|abilities]]; however, she had instead mastered the use of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Lsu's skill was said to be unmatched by any other living duelist. Her fellow Jedi recognized the Echani woman's abilities, and bestowed upon her the coveted title of [[Jedi Weapon Master|Weapon Master]] of the Order. In the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Temple]], Lsu was tasked with training all [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. One in particular, a young human male named [[Sarro Xaj]], sought to follow in Lsu's path to mastery of the Jedi weapon. She recognized the fervor in her student, and personally trained Xaj exclusively in the use of the [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]].<ref name="rot" />

===The Sith War===
{{Quote|But there will be those who doubt the totality of the Sith extinction. There will always be whispers that the Sith survive, hints and rumors that somewhere in the galaxy a Dark Lord lives. And if the Jedi ever find proof of our existence, they will be relentless in hunting us down.|Darth Bane|<ref name="rot" />}}
When Lsu's fighting skills were called upon to serve in [[Jedi Lord|Lord]] [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth's]] [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] during the [[Ruusan campaign|final campaign]] of the [[New Sith Wars]], her Padawan, Xaj, accompanied her. She wielded two [[Color/Legends|blue]]-bladed lightsabers in battle alongside Hoth against [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Skere Kaan|Kaan's]] [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. She was considered the bane of many Sith, and by the war's end, it was believed that as many of [[Sith Lord/Legends|their Lords]] had [[Death/Legends|fallen]] victim to her blades as had perished from the [[thought bomb]].<ref name="rot" />

[[997 BBY/Legends|Three years]] after the war, Lsu completed Xaj's training, and deemed him worthy of becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She continued to fulfill her training duties as Weapons Master of the Temple, while maintaining her own combat skills. She would be called upon [[990 BBY|seven years later]], when rumors began to surface of surviving Sith Lords from Kaan's Brotherhood still being active in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A Jedi Knight named [[Johun Othone]] had encountered a young man named [[Darovit]], who claimed to have proof of [[Order of the Sith Lords|at least two]] living Dark Lords. Othone immediately reported this to his former Master, [[Valenthyne Farfalla]], and the latter was determined to investigate. Farfalla sent for Master Lsu and also the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] Master [[Worror Dowmat]], both of whom Farfalla had served with on Ruusan, to aid him in his [[mission]]. Accompanied by Xaj, Othone, Worror, Farfalla, Lsu and her companions made haste for the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] on board her personal [[Starship/Legends|attack cruiser]], the ''[[Justice Crusader]]'', with intentions of destroying the Sith once and for all.<ref name="rot" />

===Mission to Tython===
{{Quote|Let's see where this takes us. Sarro, keep your trigger finger ready.|Raskta Lsu, upon entering Tython's atmosphere|<ref name="rot" />}}
[[File:Duel_on_Tython.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lsu wields her twin lightsabers during the Duel on Tython.]]
Despite her expressed reservations about traveling the potentially dangerous [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route to Tython, Lsu was appeased by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] Master Worror, who was serving as the ''Crusader''{{'s}} navigator. With the coordinates he provided, Lsu piloted the vessel, with Xaj acting as the ship's gunner, and Farfalla providing operational support for all three. Upon entry into Tython's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the Jedi noticed two other starships parked near a [[Belia Darzu's fortress|massive fortress]] as they scanned the building for life-forms, of which they found three. The ''Crusader'' landed via autopilot, and Lsu and her companions entered the fortress straightaway. Seeing two doorways, Knights Othone and Xaj were ordered through one, while Lsu and Farfalla went through the other, the plan being to eliminate the possibility of escape on the part of the Sith. Worror remained in the doorway behind his fellow Masters, and was to provide support for the whole team through his talent with Jedi [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]]. The two Sith, [[Darth/Legends|Darths]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Bane]] and [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]], were ready and waiting, and [[Duel on Tython|immediately engaged]] their foes in combat.<ref name="rot" />

Lsu was first to confront Darth Bane, only to find that he was covered in impenetrable [[orbalisk]] armor. In spite of Bane's advantage, Lsu continued her attack, while being supported by Farfalla with defensive [[Force barrier/Legends|shield-walls]]. Several times she had to save her fellow Jedi from Bane, from both the Sith Lord's powerful Force abilities and his superior skill with the lightsaber. Lsu also noticed that Bane dueled with a [[Curved-hilt lightsaber/Legends|curved-hilt]] weapon, one which gave him a critical advantage over his opponents, since use of curved-hilt lightsabers was rare and most Jedi had never encountered one.<ref name="rot" />

When it seemed as though Bane was retreating, he suddenly disengaged Lsu to attack the source of her team's Force-empowerment: Master Worror. The Ithorian was saved by a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force push]] from Othone, a maneuver that disrupted Worror's concentration and interrupted his battle meditation. Othone [[Force jump/Legends|leaped]] over to where Masters Lsu and Farfalla were, and the three of them engaged Bane from all sides, with Lsu in the middle, blending her style and attacks with those of her comrades. However, within the brief disruption in Worror's meditation, Lsu's former Padawan Xaj was overcome by the [[Summon fear|Sith mind tricks]] of Darth Zannah, and cut down. Unaware of and unprotected from the danger approaching from behind, Lsu was [[Shiak|impaled]] by Darth Zannah. She was the second of the Jedi to die on Tython, with Farfalla, Worror, and Othone falling soon thereafter.<ref name="rot" />

===Legacy===
Following her death on Tython, the Jedi High Council, alerted to the existence of Darth Bane by [[Caleb]] of [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] sent a team of Jedi, including Masters [[Tho'natu]] and [[Obba]] to destroy him. On Ambria, in Caleb's camp, the Jedi discovered the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilts]] of the slain Jedi, including Master Lsu's. Upon the team's arrival they were assaulted by a deranged [[Darovit]], whom they assumed to be Bane suffering from overexposure to the [[orbalisk armor]]. Slaying him, they deemed that the Sith were extinct, and returned the lightsaber hilts to the Temple.<ref name="rot" />

Once returned to the Temple, the Jedi created a memorial to those Jedi who were responsible for the destruction of the Sith. All five Jedi's lightsaber hilts were set into a large white stone block in the gardens around the base of the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]]. Under each hilt was a depiction of its wielder, along with their name.<ref name="doe">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Stay back! You'll just get in the way.|Lsu, to Farfalla|<ref name="rot" />}}
Raskta Lsu was a tall, well-muscled, fair-skinned woman, with pure-white hair and silver eyes that were prevalent among the Echani race. She was an ambitious youth who sought complete perfection of her skills and worked tirelessly to achieve that goal.<ref name="rot" />

A responsible Jedi Master, Lsu readily accepted and fulfilled her duties as Weapons Master by training all the Order's [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] in lightsaber combat. She was also confident in her own dueling aptitude, and readily accepted the call for action as a soldier in the Jedi's Army of Light. Her determination to defeat the Sith was realized as she battled during the Ruusan campaign from the front lines.<ref name="rot" />

Lsu's recognition of her own skills also afforded her an air of confidence; when she realized that her colleague Farfalla would only be a hindrance to her against Darth Bane, she did not hesitate to tell him so. Farfalla also recognized her superior skill, and allowed Lsu the space she required to directly face the Dark Lord, something he himself was incapable of.<ref name="rot" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|The handle!|Raskta Lsu, recognizing Darth Bane's unique lightsaber hilt|<ref name="rot" />}}
As the esteemed Weapon Master of the Jedi Order, Raskta Lsu's greatest talents were in lightsaber combat. Her Echani ideals of perfection through mastery of one's physical self were incorporated into her Jedi training, and she was eventually recognized by her peers as the greatest duelist of her time. By the end of war she had taken as many darksider lives as the Thought Bomb,<ref name="rot" /> over a thousand Sith.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Jedi Knight'' audio drama]]</ref><ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

A master of all forms of lightsaber combat, Lsu's preferred style was [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]], one she implemented with two blue blades. Lsu was so proficient in battle that she was able to switch between dueling styles seamlessly, a tactic that often confused her opponents. She could duel a single adversary with several partners, playing off of their unique styles to maximize the effectiveness of her own. Lsu was also adept with the double-bladed variant as well, which she trained her Padawan, Sarro Xaj, in the use of. She was even familiar with the hooked-handle lightsaber, to the point of being able to immediately recognize it while in the thick of combat. She would have killed Darth Bane if the Sith was not in lightsaber-immune [[Orbalisk armor]].<ref name="rot" />

In battle against a user of said weapon, Lsu was able to modify her own technique to compensate for the slight variance that resulted from the curved-hilt's usage. Jedi Knight Johun Othone regarded her as a terrifying figure to behold on the battlefield. She eschewed the use of armor, a trait common among Echani, her only protection being the blue-bladed lightsabers held in each hand.<ref name="rot" />

However, Raskta Lsu displayed considerably less talent in applications of the Force. She had exchanged much study in dramatic the ways of the Force for exclusive devotion to training with lightsabers and honing her body and powers that aided her in combat. Because of this, her melee skills mostly compensated for her limited powers. This said, she was able to [[Force jump/Legends|Force jump]] and [[Force valor|fought like a blur]].<ref name="rot" />

In battle, Lsu gained greatly from being shielded by others while she cut down her foes. During her duel with Darth Bane, she was nearly killed by a Force Wave, saved only by Farfalla's shield. However, Bane's Force Wave technique was incredibly advanced, and Lsu would have met her end on the precipice of a sharp rock. The presence of a Jedi proficient with battle meditation magnified Lsu's fighting excellence exponentially, though she was still a formidable combatant without such support and was the sole participant that could face Darth Bane, even though her compatriots were also bolstered by Worror's technique.<ref name="rot" />

With all her fighting experience, however, Lsu's [[Precognition/Legends|natural danger sense]] instincts did not avail her to Zannah, who used a spell of concealment to mask her approach, leading to the Echani's end with a backstab saber-thrust.<ref name="rot" />

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[Drew Karpyshyn]] created the character of Raskta Lsu for the second of his ''Darth Bane'' novels, titled [[Darth Bane: Rule of Two|''Rule of Two'']], which was released in [[2007]].<ref name="rot" /> In [[2012]], she received her first visual depiction in the reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', in an image by the artist [[Chris Scalf]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
